definitions.full: H2787. charar I. [ חָרַר ] verb be hot, scorched, burn poet . & late (Arabic be hot, burn, thirst ; Ethiopic Aramaic חַר ; compare Assyrian arâru , glow , SASm Assurbanipal i. p. 97 Belser BAS ii. 155 ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular חָ֫רָה Job 30:30 , וְחָ֫רָה consecutive Ezek 24:11 , חָ֫רוּ Isa 24:6 ; — 1 be hot, scorched , Jerusalem, under figure of caldron Ezek 24:11 . 2 burn = be burned , figurative of men, in ׳י s judgement, Isa 24:6 . 3 burn , of bones of sick men in fever ׳ח מִנִּיחֹֿרֶב Job 30:30 . Niph`al Perfect נָחַר Jer 6:29 , נָחָ֑ר Ezek 15:4 , נִחַר Psa 69:4 ; 3 plural נִחָ֑רוּ 102:4 (Kö i. 368 ); Imperfect וַיֵּחָ֑ר Ezek 15:5 יֵחָ֑רוּ 24:10 (strike out Co B and others) 1 be scorched , of bellows מַמֻּחַ in fierce fire Jer 6:29 **from √ נחר snort, puff , according to Mich Ew Gf Gie and others, — Du; (figurative); scorched, charred , of the vine (as fuel) Ezek 15:4-5 , middle part charred, the ends devoured ( אכל ) by fire (simile of inhabitants of Jerusalem); bones (simile id. ) 24:10 (see above). 2 burn , of bones in fever Psa 102:4 ( כְּמוֺקֵד , compare Qal Job 30:30 ); be parched , of throat ׳נח גרוני Job 69:4. — Isa 41:11 ; 45:24 ; Song 1:6 see חרה .
